description: Issues a new token for the same principal. Every site carries over. Inputs: token, and optional overlap_seconds from 0 to 300. The previous token stops working immediately when overlap_seconds is omitted or 0. During a non-zero overlap window both tokens work. After that window the previous token returns 401 token_revoked. The new token is returned once.

overlap_seconds.description: Seconds the previous token keeps working so an in-flight deploy can finish. Omit or 0 to invalidate it immediately. Maximum 300.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: rotate_token
title: Rotate the owner token
